analogy.rationale: This class targets ion transporters/channels (SLC12A1/3, ATP1A1, carbonic anhydrases, KCNMA1) that are largely not coupled to transcriptional programs in these cell lines, so responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other ion transport/channel classes and ATPase/carbonic anhydrase inhibitors that share the same targets.
